notes.title: Psycho Fear Update 1.35 is Here!
notes.notes:
Psycho Fear Update 1.35 is Here! 

We’re excited to share what’s new in Psycho Fear with our latest update! This version adds fresh content, improved gameplay mechanics, and more challenging encounters to keep you on the edge of your seat.

🔸 New Puzzles in Level 2: Two new puzzles have been added to Level 2 to intensify the challenge.

🔸 Timed Doors in Maze Corridors: Two timed doors now await you in the maze corridors of Level 2. 

🔸 New Lore Note: Discover more of the dark lore with a new note added to Level 2.

🔸 Usable Objects: All accessible objects in Level 2 are now usable, so interact and see what you find!

🔸 Final Boss AI Improvement: The final boss has become even more fearsome! It now patrols back and forth. Stay vigilant!

🔸 Redemption in the Final Corridor: Redemption is now possible in the final corridor, adding a new layer to the end-game experience.

🔸 Hints for the Painting Puzzle in Level 3: Struggling with the painting puzzle? We’ve added hints in Level 3 to guide you.

🔸 Level Selection Menu in Lobby: A level selection menu has been introduced in the lobby to give players a sneak peek of the upcoming map!

Update now and dive back into the chilling world of Psycho Fear. See if you have what it takes to survive the horrors that await!

notes.title: Psycho Fear Evolves for an Even More Intense Experience!
notes.notes:
We heard you, and we made it happen! You asked for more flexibility, and it's here with the Redemption update.

- In solo mode, death is no longer the end. Face the challenges, explore the levels without the fear of a game over. And now, the amount of karma is no longer an obstacle for redemption. But be warned—each redemption still comes with a price...

- In co-op mode, solidarity prevails! We've added the redemption system just like in solo mode, so now you and your team can support each other in the face of danger. Unity is strength, even in the face of the worst horrors.

Psycho Fear is a living, evolving game, constantly shaped by your feedback. Keep sharing your thought we love hearing from you! And above all, brace yourself for new scares, because we’re far from done surprising you...

notes.title: Official Launch of Psycho Fear
notes.notes:
Today marks the official launch of Psycho Fear, a heart-pounding escape room experience developed by Dark Panda and Equinox Games. 

This escape room-style game, available in solo or online co-op mode for 2 to 3 players, throws players into a dark, nerve-wracking environment where they must solve challenging puzzles, overcome deadly obstacles, and fight relentless enemies to escape.

With an average playtime of 2 to 3 hours, Psycho Fear will keep you on the edge of your seat from start to finish. 

In Psycho Fear, death can occur at any moment. If you quit the game, you will lose your progress as there are no save points. However, in solo mode, you can redeem yourself using karma points, allowing you to come back to life and continue your journey. In co-op mode, there is no redemption system, but players can revive each other using Serum Y syringes.

Don't miss out on your chance to experience the horror of Psycho Fear, priced at $8.99 US during the first week.

notes.title: Dark Panda and Equinox Games Announce Collaboration on Upcoming Game Psycho Fear
notes.notes:
Dark Panda and Equinox Games, have officially signed a collaborative agreement to co-develop the highly anticipated game, Psycho Fear. The partnership aims to combine the strengths and expertise of both companies to deliver a next-level gaming experience to players worldwide.

Psycho Fear is  a heart-pounding survival-horror experience inspired by the hit movie franchise "Saw." In Psycho Fear, players are trapped and must use their wit and determination to escape the clutches of a twisted psychopath and survive. With challenging puzzles, deadly obstacles, and an intense atmosphere, this game delivers a nerve-wracking experience that can be enjoyed solo or with up to three players in co-op mode.

Dark Panda has been working on the concept of Psycho Fear since February 2022. The initial press release and  teaser was launched on February 14th 2023, showcasing the gripping atmosphere and intense gameplay that await players. 

The decision to join forces stems from a shared vision to revolutionize the gaming landscape and offer fans a truly immersive and unforgettable experience. With the combined talents of Dark Panda's innovative storytelling and Equinox Games' cutting-edge gameplay mechanics, Psycho Fear promises to bring a unique and exciting twist to the gaming world.

Dark Panda, established in 2022, is a video game studio focused on creating immersive and captivating gaming experiences.

Equinox is a trailblazing, globally distributed game development company that specializes in creating cutting-edge multiplayer experiences and robust backend solutions. By harnessing the talents of professionals from around the world, we pride ourselves on delivering exceptional results while fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration.
